evals.prompt: Start a multi-phase refactoring project that needs to survive context changes.
evals.expected_output: Orient by reading AGENTS.md, .agents/MEMORY.md, handoffs, and active sessions; create one timestamped session directory under .agents/brain/sessions/active/ with meta/, implementation_plan.md, tasks.md, and walkthrough.md before editing.
expectations: Checks .agents/MEMORY.md and active sessions before creating a new session
Creates implementation_plan.md, tasks.md, and walkthrough.md under .agents/brain/sessions/active/
Creates goal.md only if requested or required

evals.prompt: Mark a Maestro session DONE after fixing all listed tasks.
evals.expected_output: Verify every acceptance criterion against exact final artifacts, re-read changed non-code files in full, update walkthrough.md with verification evidence, and set State: DONE.
expectations: Verifies all acceptance criteria against exact final artifacts
Records verification commands and evidence in walkthrough.md
Marks tasks [x] only after artifact verification

evals.prompt: Start work on a new feature in a project whose .agents/brain/sessions/active holds two DONE Maestro sessions and one EXECUTING Maestro session untouched for 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Before creating the new Maestro session, run sessions.py status and stale --apply: the DONE sessions are archived, the idle one is closed as ABANDONED and archived, evidence files move to ~/.agents/evidence, INDEX.md lists all three, and the user gets a one-line closure report.
expectations: ls .agents/brain/sessions/active shows only the new Maestro session
no png, jpg, webp, log, or zip file remains under .agents/brain/sessions/archive
